description.narrative: THE PROJECT AIMS AT THE CONSTRUCTION OF A THIRD WATER TRANSMISSION LINE NOMINAL DIAMETER DN (1400) BETWEEN SINN LAKE AND LATAKIA RESERVOIRS,PARALLEL TO THE EXISTING TWO LINES (DN 700 MM AND DN 1000 MM) IN ORDER TO BOOST THE TOTAL CAPACITY OF WATER TRANSMISSION FROM 1.5M3/SEC (ANNEX_1). THIS WILL CATER FOR THE INCREASING DEMAND FOR POTABLE WATER IN SEVEN RURAL DISTRICTS AND LATAKIA CITY UP TO 2020.
